e5_lists.built_from: every state of data/interim/state_anchor.parquet, by the factor rule (Joe's ruling of 2026-11-19); the report block is checked against it
e5_lists.ruling_of_2026_11_19: Resolve E5's omitted states against the actual adopted factor rule: valid computed factors of 3.0 meet the exclusion threshold; fallback values receive the adopted fallback treatment.

definition.source: pipeline/facilities/build_inventory.py, state_anchor(); reported in data/frozen/inventory_report.json, state_anchor
definition.raw_factor: (EPRI's 2024 state total minus the measured (Epoch and operator-reported) load in 2024, floored at zero) divided by the 2024 permit-based load; undefined where the permit-based load is zero
definition.factor: raw_factor clipped to [SCALE_LO, SCALE_HI] = [0.2, 3.0]; where raw_factor is undefined, the fallback 1.0
definition.flag: small_state where EPRI's total is under 0.25 TWh, else no_dated_permits where raw_factor is undefined, undercounted above 3.0, overcounted below 0.2, ok otherwise (checked in that order)
definition.report_block: the report keeps only states whose EPRI total is 0.25 TWh or more (build_inventory.main); the factor is applied to every state's permit-based rows, including those left out of the block
definition.applied_to: permit-based rows only; measured rows are not scaled
definition.lists: built from every state of data/interim/state_anchor.parquet by the factor rule (Joe's ruling of 2026-11-19): a computed factor (raw factor defined) of 2 or more is dropped, the cap of 3.0 included, small state or not; the fallback 1.0 (raw factor undefined) is flagged and named on the second list, not dropped; computed factors at the lower limit of 0.2 are reported and on neither list, which Joe adopted on 2026-11-19 (D-111) for the four the plan names; any other is not decided

lists_before_the_ruling_of_2026_11_19.built_from: inventory_report.json's state_anchor block alone (states with an EPRI total of 0.25 TWh or more)
